profile.title: Business profile
profile.contactSub: Scan to book an appointment, or save this store as a contact.
profile.phoneLockedHint: Your phone number is your sign-in and your page's web address, so it can only be changed by TejoTime support.
profile.categoryHint: Sets the wording used across your public page.
profile.heroSubtitleHint: The line under the big heading at the top of your page.
profile.yearInvalid: Enter a valid year between 1800 and 2100.
profile.heroImageHint: The large picture at the top of your page.
profile.socialHint: Shown as icons at the bottom of your page. Paste the full profile address, or clear a box to hide it.
profile.galleryHint: The gallery on your page. The first photo shows largest — use Move up to reorder.
profile.amenitiesEmpty: Nothing listed. These are the small perks shown on your page — air conditioning, parking, Wi‑Fi.
profile.faqsHint: Shown as a FAQ on your page. Blank rows are dropped when you save.
profile.reviewsHint: Quotes shown on your page. These are the ones you choose to feature — your star rating is worked out by TejoTime and cannot be edited here.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: How this store's customer website looks. Nothing is applied until you save.
appearance.openSiteMissing: Add a store phone number before opening the customer site.
appearance.previewHint: Updates as you change colours and theme — not saved until you tap Save.
appearance.previewNotResponding: Preview loaded but is not live. Reload, or make sure the customer site supports preview.
appearance.previewUnavailable: Could not load the customer site preview. Check EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL and that the site is reachable.
appearance.previewNeedsRebuild: Live in-app preview needs a native rebuild (react-native-webview). Use Open customer site for now, or run npx expo run:android / run:ios.
appearance.previewDemo: No store phone yet — showing the demo store so you can still preview the look.
appearance.invalidHex: Enter a valid hex color like #2563EB.
appearance.brandHint: One color seeds buttons, links and the banner.
appearance.aaManualFail: Label choice is below 4.5:1 ({ratio}:1). Consider Auto or a darker brand.

team.title: Team logins
team.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what each of them sees
team.noChairWarn: Pick a chair — without one they see an empty queue and calendar.
team.chairRequired: Pick a chair. You cannot add more staff logins than you have chairs.
team.noFreeChairs: All chairs are linked. Add another chair under Settings → Staff before creating a new staff login.
team.coOwnerBlurb: Same access as you. Can add and manage staff. Cannot change your owner account.
team.staffBlurb: Sees only what you allow, and only their own chair's queue and appointments.
team.name: Name
team.phoneHint: This is what they sign in with. Include the country code.
team.tempPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it once signed in.
team.chairHint: Required. Each staff login needs its own chair — you cannot add more staff than you have chairs.
team.coOwnerNote: A co-owner gets everything you have, including adding and removing staff. They cannot change your owner account.
team.fullAccessSuper: Full access. Created by TejoTime when this store was set up — change it from the admin panel.
team.fullAccessCo: Full access to everything, the same as you.
team.createdToast: Login created. Share the password with them.
team.permissionsSavedToast: Permissions saved. They apply on their next sign-in, or within 15 minutes.
team.chairUnlinkedToast: Chair unlinked. They will not see any queue or appointments.
team.passwordResetToast: Password reset. Share the new one with them.
team.turnOffConfirm: Turn off {name}? They will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign back in.
